name: How should I prepare my kitchen before the countertop installers arrive?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my kitchen before the countertop installers arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clear all small appliances, dishware, and food off your countertops and empty the lower base cabinets beneath the sink and cooktop. Clear an open walkway from your home entrance to the kitchen so crews can carry heavy stone slabs safely. If you are changing your sink, faucet, or drop-in cooktop, have those new fixtures on-site prior to templating day. This allows installers to take exact cut-out measurements, ensuring the fabricated stone fits your plumbing fixtures accurately.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear all countertops, empty the sink base cabinet, ensure a clear path for heavy stone, and have your new sink, faucet, and cooktop on-site for accurate template measurements.
